text:
Revise the retained unexecuted composition using the existing TaskPlan kinds/bindings only. Preserve every accepted requirement and public output contract, one public query, first at most ten products in observed order, actual individual product visits, actual workbook writing at the accepted path and browser closure on failure. No extra ranking, sponsored filtering, deduplication, fabricated values or permissions.
Correct the invalid requires bindings with typed boolean predicates; a nullable string/reference is not a condition. Retain local required assertions and verified producer success/completeness checks. present(task) only establishes completion, not success or non-null fields.
Apply the tested compact composition, not just the three type fixes: complete bounded pages -> extract mode each over those pages with one sole array output, whose item is a compact candidate array -> flatten directly in the next consumer -> global interpretation selecting IDs only -> lookup against offered candidates, export those validated IDs with the minimum necessary projection -> lookup against the original observed records -> real product iteration. All original pages/records remain retained separately; minimally project their record arrays in one foreach when needed. Do not field-select an array. Every page is processed; never impose the ten-product decision bound on extraction coverage. Keep exact observed actions/URLs out of the decision view unless truly needed to choose. A returned ID never grants a reference/URL invented by interpretation.
Extract only the immediate consumer contract. For product pages, extract each complete page into narrow observed name/description/price facts, then perform genuine reconciliation over only those compact facts and observed producer errors when necessary. Keep non-null product records with the accepted nullable missing fields. Pure copying, assembly, flatten and lookup go in bindings/exports. Export the product loop result directly; do not interpret merely to assemble typed products or re-declare success. Keep the explicit bounded TSV formatting transform over at most ten compact records because the writer accepts text. Return the artifact path from the successful writer output and completed from verified status; derive errors from observed errors, not a success-claim interpretation.
For initial search controls, use the same bounded extraction/compact-selection/original-lookup pattern instead of interpreting the full snapshot. Keep navigation, actual search submission and later reads. Remove the unsolicited optional accept_cookies_if_present/click_cookie_accept subworkflow and its duplicated analysis; those actions are absent from the accepted requirements. Actual unusable observations or blocked required actions must fail truthfully. Do not automatically manufacture a blocker or success. No raw snapshot input to global interpretation; no changed limits or new task primitives. This is an explicit structural composition revision, not artifact execution approval.
